description: Complete guide to Trnava, Trnava Region: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Trnava is a city in Trnava Region with a population of 64,735. Little Rome of Slovakia, a city of beautiful Baroque churches and religious architecture, with a historic old town and a growing automotive and electronics industry. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
